name: OnSpace AI
description_en:
OnSpace AI builds web and mobile apps from prompts, reference files and designs. Its getting-started guide describes mobile work using React Native and Expo, iterative changes and device/web previews.

Generated code can be connected to GitHub, while backend choices include the built-in Cloud Alpha and a separate Supabase integration. Treat code sync, project visibility and end-user data authorization as distinct decisions. A useful pilot should test each boundary before adding real users or data.
description_zh:
OnSpace AI 通过提示词、参考文件及设计构建网页和移动应用。入门指南描述使用 React Native、Expo 开发移动端，逐次修改并进行设备／网页预览。

生成代码可连接 GitHub，后端可选择内建 Cloud Alpha 或独立 Supabase 集成。代码同步、项目可见性和最终用户数据授权属于不同决策，应在加入真实用户或数据前分别测试。

core_features.name_zh: 默认分支 Git 同步
core_features.explanation_en: OnSpace commits editor changes to the repository default branch and pulls external changes from that branch.
core_features.explanation_zh: OnSpace 将编辑器改动提交到仓库默认分支，并从该分支拉取外部改动。

core_features.explanation_en: The documented backend combines authentication, PostgreSQL, storage and edge functions under an Alpha label.
core_features.explanation_zh: 文档后端组合鉴权、PostgreSQL、存储及边缘函数，并明确标为 Alpha。

core_features.explanation_en: Choose public/private project visibility independently of repository or app data rules.
core_features.explanation_zh: 项目公开／私有设置需与仓库及应用数据规则分别考虑。

en: Evaluate a small mobile/web tool with synthetic login data.
Check code portability alongside a separately provisioned backend.
zh: 用模拟登录数据评估小型移动／网页工具。
同时核对代码迁移及独立后端配置。
use_cases.basis: Proposed evaluation tasks derived from documentation; no observed customer outcomes.

steps.en: Define a narrow task, select visibility and create a disposable preview.
steps.zh: 定义单一任务、选择可见性并建立可丢弃预览。

steps.en: Review repository permissions, default-branch sync and backend access; test authentication email delivery before production use.
steps.zh: 检查仓库权限、默认分支同步及后端访问，生产前测试鉴权邮件送达。

items.en: Cloud is explicitly documented as Alpha.
items.zh: Cloud 文档明确标为 Alpha。

items.en: Default-branch code history does not prove data recovery or backend portability.
items.zh: 默认分支代码历史不能证明数据恢复或后端可迁移。

pricing.summary_en: Free has 500 daily credits capped at 2,000/month and public projects. Pro is $25/month with up to 7,500 credits and private projects; Enterprise is custom. Usage cost varies with task complexity. Backend/provider charges, training terms and actual checkout total need separate confirmation.
pricing.summary_zh: Free 每日 500 积分、每月最多 2,000，项目公开；Pro 每月 $25，最多 7,500 积分及私有项目，Enterprise 定制报价。消耗随任务复杂度变化，后端／服务商费用、训练条款及实际结账总额需单独核对。

review_notes: Original AI research draft based on the cited public official pages; no publication, price approval, independent review or product test is implied.
Earlier third-party feature and price claims are retained only in discovery provenance, not as current product evidence.

sections.title_en: Review one behavior at a time
sections.en: The quick start recommends planning user actions, generating an initial app and refining it in small iterations. Preview on mobile and web to check behavior rather than accepting a broad feature request as proof that every scenario exists. Define a reproducible acceptance task before changing the next feature.
sections.zh: 入门指南建议先规划用户动作，再生成初始应用并逐次调整。应通过移动及网页预览核对行为，不能将宽泛功能请求视为所有场景已实现。每次增加功能前，先定义可重复的验收任务。

sections.title_zh: 明确选择仓库访问范围
sections.en: GitHub setup requires account authorization and app installation with all-repository or selected-repository access. The guide says newly created repositories are private by default. Select only the intended test repository during evaluation and inspect the connection state; no authorization or installation was performed in this research.
sections.zh: GitHub 设置需要账户授权及应用安装，可选择全部或指定仓库访问。指南称新建仓库默认私有。评估时应仅选择目标测试仓库并检查连接状态；本研究未执行授权或安装。

sections.en: Editor changes create commits pushed directly to the default branch; external default-branch commits return to the editor. Feature-branch work remains invisible until merged there. Plan collaboration and external deployment around this documented boundary, and verify conflict/recovery behavior rather than assuming every Git workflow is supported.
sections.zh: 编辑器改动形成提交并直接推到默认分支，外部默认分支提交同步回编辑器。功能分支在合并前不可见。协作及外部部署应围绕这一边界规划，冲突／恢复行为仍需实测，不能假定所有 Git 工作流都受支持。

sections.title_en: Evaluate Alpha Cloud and external Supabase separately
sections.title_zh: 分别评估 Alpha Cloud 与外部 Supabase
sections.en: Cloud Alpha documents managed PostgreSQL, authentication, storage and edge functions. The separate Supabase guide requires its own account, organization/project selection and authorization. Do not assume an exported code repository includes either backend’s data, credentials or operating configuration. Validate the chosen deployment as a complete system.
sections.zh: Cloud Alpha 文档描述托管 PostgreSQL、鉴权、存储及边缘函数。独立 Supabase 指南要求另有账户、组织／项目选择及授权。不能假定导出的代码仓库包含任一后端的数据、凭据或运行配置，应按完整系统验证部署。

sections.title_en: Separate email copy from delivery infrastructure
sections.title_zh: 区分邮件文案与投递基础设施
sections.en: Cloud’s Templates controls authentication email content; SMTP Settings controls the sender/provider. The guide recommends custom SMTP for production. Test signup and recovery messages, sender configuration and denied access using synthetic identities. The presence of built-in RLS does not demonstrate that a particular generated app’s rules are correct.
sections.zh: Cloud 的 Templates 控制鉴权邮件内容，SMTP Settings 控制发送者／服务商。指南建议生产使用自定义 SMTP。应以模拟身份测试注册和恢复邮件、发件配置及拒绝访问。内建 RLS 不代表某个生成应用的规则已经正确。

sections.title_en: Public projects and credit ceilings matter
sections.title_zh: 重视公开项目与积分上限
sections.en: Free is $0 with public projects and 500 daily credits subject to a 2,000 monthly ceiling. Pro is $25/month with up to 7,500 credits and private projects. A daily allowance does not continue beyond the monthly cap. Project sharing and private repositories are separate from end-user authorization inside the published app.
sections.zh: Free 为 $0，项目公开，每日 500 积分但每月最多 2,000；Pro 每月 $25，最多 7,500 积分并支持私有项目。月度上限用完后不能继续凭每日额度使用。项目分享和私有仓库也不同于已发布应用的最终用户授权。
